description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for an App Gateway component within the WPEFramework, including resolver, authenticator, responder, request handler, and telemetry interfaces, as well as the GatewayContext structure.

classes.name: GatewayContext
classes.description: Structure holding request, connection, and application identifiers for gateway operations.

classes.name: IAppGatewayResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving gateway requests, allowing configuration of resolution paths and request resolution.

classes.name: IAppGatewayAuthenticator
classes.description: Interface for authenticating connections, retrieving session IDs, and checking permission groups.

classes.name: IAppGatewayResponder
classes.description: Interface for responding, emitting notifications, forwarding requests, and managing connection context.

classes.name: IAppGatewayResponder::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for connection state changes.

classes.name: IAppGatewayRequestHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling incoming gateway requests.

classes.name: IAppGatewayTelemetry
classes.description: Interface for recording telemetry events and metrics related to gateway operations.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Adds additional resolution paths to the gateway.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a request based on the provided context, origin, method, and parameters.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates an incoming connection and retrieves the associated appId.

methods.name: GetSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the session ID for a given appId.

methods.name: CheckPermissionGroup
methods.description: Checks if an app belongs to a specified permission group.

methods.name: Respond
methods.description: Sends a response payload for a given context.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Emits a notification to a given context with a specified method and payload.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Forwards a request to the client with specified connection ID, request ID, method, and parameters.

methods.name: GetGatewayConnectionContext
methods.description: Retrieves connection context parameters such as headers or URL parameters.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification interface for connection events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification interface for connection events.

methods.name: HandleAppGatewayRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming gateway requests and provides responses.

methods.name: RecordTelemetryEvent
methods.description: Records a telemetry event with context information.

methods.name: RecordTelemetryMetric
methods.description: Records a telemetry metric with context information.
